cards.audioText: Your call sign is NWA89, destination Beijing, 5100m maintaining, approaching KM, expect KM01 arrival, runway 36L, information J, now contact Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是NWA（美西北）89，目的地北京，5100米保持，正在接近KM，预计KM01进场，跑道36左，通播J，现在联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, NWA89, 5100m maintaining, approaching KM, expect KM01 arrival, runway 36L, information J.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美西北89，5100米保持，正在接近KM，预计KM01进场，跑道36左，通播J。

cards.audioText: NWA89, Beijing Approach, cleared for KM01 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36L, descend to and maintain 2700m on QNH 1010.
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，北京进近，可以KM01进场，预计跑道36左盲降进近，下降保持修正海压2700米，修正海压1010。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for KM01 arrival, expect ILS approach, runway 36L, descend to and maintain 2700m on QNH 1010, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以KM01进场，预计跑道36左盲降进近，下降保持修正海压2700米，修正海压1010，美西北89。

cards.audioText: Tell the Approach that your GPWS is out of service.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉北京进近飞机的近地警告系统不工作了。
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美西北89，近地警告系统故障。

cards.audioText: NWA89, Beijing roger, can you land normally, say intention. [Tell the approach that it is not serious, you can land normally.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，收到，能否正常着陆，说明意图。【告诉北京进近问题不严重，可以正常着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, able to land normally, GPWS failure not serious, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，可以正常着陆，近地警告系统故障不严重，美西北89。

cards.audioText: NWA89, Beijing roger, descend to and maintain 900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，北京收到，下降保持900米。

cards.audioText: NWA89, turn right heading 330 intercept localizer for runway 36L, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，右转航向330切入跑道36左航道，建立报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330 intercept localizer for runway 36L, report established, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向330，切入跑道36左航向道，建立报告，美西北89。

cards.audioText: Report established on localizer 5 miles final runway 36L.
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, NWA89, established on localizer 5 miles final runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美西北89，五边5海里，建立航道36左。

cards.audioText: NWA89, continue approach and contact Beijing Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，继续进近，联系北京塔台118.1。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach and contact Beijing Tower 118.1, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，联系北京塔台118.，美西北89。

cards.audioText: Report to Tower that you have established ILS.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，美西北89，建立盲降。

cards.audioText: NWA89, cleared to land runway 36L, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，可以着陆36左，脱离报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 36L, report vacated, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以着陆36L，脱离后报告，美西北89。

cards.audioText: NWA89, confirm altitude, mode C shows you're too low.[The PAPI shows three red lights, but according to your PFD, your aircraft is high on the glide path. Report to the Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，证实C模式应答机高度模式打开，你高度显示太低。【PAPI显示三个红灯，但根据主飞行显示器，飞机高于下滑道，将情况报告给塔台。】
cards.referenceText: The PAPI indicates we are a little bit low but PFD shows we are high on the glide path, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: PAPI显示飞机位置低，但飞行显示器显示飞机高于下滑道，美西北89。

cards.audioText: NWA89, say intention.[Tell the Tower you're going around.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，说明意图。【告诉塔台你准备复飞。】
美西北89，上升2100米，联系离场119.9。
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升2100米，联系离场119.9，美西北89。

cards.audioText: You are climbing to 2100m, call Beijing Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已上升到2100米，联系北京离场。】
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，美西北89，上升2100米。

cards.audioText: NWA89, roger, say intention.[Tell the Departure you want to circle back for another landing on runway 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，收到，说明意图。【告诉离场你想机动飞行一圈后转回跑道36右着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Request circle back for another landing on runway 36R, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求机动飞行一圈后转回跑道36右着陆，美西北89。

cards.audioText: NWA89, roger, turn right heading 090 for crosswind.
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，收到，右转航向090加入二边。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090 for crosswind, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向090加入两边，美西北89。

cards.audioText: NWA89, what is the status of your aircraft?[Tell the controller your aircraft is in good condition, but now you don't have enough fuel for another missed approach. You want a successful landing this time.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，飞机现在什么情况？【告诉管制员飞机情况良好，但是你没有足够燃料再次复飞，你希望这次能成功着陆。】
cards.referenceText: The aircraft is in good condition, but I don't have enough fuel for another missed approach. I need to make a good landing this time, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机状况良好，但没有足够燃料再次复飞，这次我需要成功着陆，美西北89。
